narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, multiply the squares in a piece by how many pieces fill the chikki. You should get twenty four every time.
<bookmark mark='same'/>The strip and the tall triangle have different shapes, but both are one sixth.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the check: squares in a piece × number of pieces = 24, for example 3 × 8 = 24 and 4 × 6 = 24; the strip (d) and the tall triangle (f) sit side by side, both 1/6

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says the small triangle touches six squares, so it covers six squares. It is half of a block of six squares, so it covers only three, and the bubble is struck.
